Favorites genres: Fantasy, Comedy, Action, Adventure, Romance

div.div: Haruka has been living his high school life as a loner, but all of a sudden, he and his classmates are summoned into another world. A God gives him a list of skills he can freely pick... Or at least that was how it was supposed to be, as all the valuable skills have been taken by the other classmates first. After Haruka scolded God, he snapped back and gave all the remaining bad skills to Haruka. Thanks to the "Loner" skill, Haruka begins his lonely adventure in another world. (Source: Muse Asia) Note: Each episode streamed a week early on some streaming services. The original TV broadcast started on October 4th, 2024.

Whoever steps foot inside that manor is said to be turned into a beautiful woman and meant to serve the young lady there as her personal maid. One day, a treasure hunter named Barredo hears about a treasure hidden within and steps foot into the abandoned house. There, a mysterious girl with numerous maids awaits him and suddenly changes him into Anya, a girl from the bar Barredo likes to frequent. Soon after, Barredo gets fucked long and hard by the girl who is apparently packing both bits! It’s only then that he comes to know the true pleasure a woman can feel... (Source: Coolmic)
Imaizumin-chi wa Douyara Gal no Tamariba ni Natteru Rashii

Some gyarus have decided to use Imaizumi's house as a gathering spot to play video games and eat snacks. When Reina gets bored with video games, she sets her sights on another toy in the house: Imaizumi himself...
(Source: Fakku!)
Music video for the song Seishi!! Loli Kami Requiem by Ui Shigure.
Seven Knights Revolution: Eiyuu no Keishousha

Long ago, Heroes had saved this world. Many Heroes fought against the powers of Destruction and protected the world. Years in the future… The Heroes had disappeared as the years passed and those possessing their powers called Successors now have the fate of the world in their hands. One of the elite Successors known as the Seven Knights is fighting an army of the Destruction when she saves a boy named Nemo. During the battle, Nemo awakens the powers of a Hero even he didn't know about and displays his powers as a Successor. But his Hero is someone who no one knew and no one ever spoke of.
(Source: Crunchyroll)

Aqua’s desire for revenge takes center stage as he navigates the dark underbelly of the entertainment world alongside his twin sister, Ruby. While Ruby follows in their slain mother’s footsteps to become an idol, Aqua joins a famous theater troupe in hopes of uncovering clues to the identity of his father — the man who arranged their mother’s untimely death, and the man who once starred in the same troupe Aqua hopes to infiltrate.
(Source: HIDIVE)

Having spent his childhood in the slums, Hajime Shinonome desperately sought strength to survive.
Now, he enjoys a peaceful and carefree life as a resident adventurer of the Komai Village.
One day, during a quest, he ventured into a dungeon and finds a young girl being partially eaten by a weakest kind of monster, a slime!
The girl's name was Lirui. Having been abandoned by her parents, she had no place to go and entered the dungeon alone in order to stay alive. Hajime couldn't just leave her there, so he took her back to the village to live with him! (Source: Crunchyroll)
Comedy, Ecchi, Romance, Slice of Life

Takane Takamine is the goddess of her high school. With perfect grades, athletic prowess, and unrivaled beauty, this student council president is the apple of everyone's eye-including Koushi Shirota, a below-average student with no friends or social prospects whatsoever. But he'll soon find out the secret behind Takamine's unbelievable success-her underwear! When she strips, she can undo any of her past actions, and now that Koushi knows, Takamine won't let him off so easy...
(Source: Yen Press)

In a world where awakened beings called “Hunters” must battle deadly monsters to protect humanity, Seong Jin-U, nicknamed “the weakest hunter of all mankind,” finds himself in a constant struggle for survival. One day, after a brutal encounter in an overpowered dungeon wipes out his party and threatens to end his life, a mysterious System chooses him as its sole player: Jin-U has been granted the rare opportunity to level up his abilities, possibly beyond any known limits. Follow Jin-U’s journey as he takes on ever-stronger enemies, both human and monster, to discover the secrets deep within the dungeons and the ultimate extent of his powers. (Source: Tappytoon) Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.
Yuusha ni Zenbu Ubawareta Ore wa Yuusha no Hahaoya to Party wo Kumimashita!

Ceres thought his life was over after being abruptly kicked out of the Hero’s party by the arrogant Hero Zect. Alone and dejected, he stumbles upon an unusual slave market, where he finds none other than the Hero’s own mother, Shizuko! Ceres has a thing for older women, and realizes that this is his chance to achieve a lifelong dream: Assembling a harem of MILFs! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Hentai, Romance

"Why did I turn into a character from an adult game?" The time has come now to take action! Lucius the loser character has transformed into a villain overnight. With his new found vengeance, Lucius will set out to enjoy the action packed, harem fantasy adventure!! (Source: TOPTOON+) Note: Includes four extra chapters.
Tensei Colosseum: Saijaku Skill de Saikyou no Onna-tachi wo Kouryaku Shite Dorei Harem Tsukurimasu

The story begins when high school boy Mikagami, whose only redeeming feature is his skills in video games, is summoned to a different world. He has only the weakest skill "Copy" and, for being useless, he is turned into a sword-fighting slave in the coliseum. Mikagami is pale in the face of the coliseum, where the worst punishment is that "the loser becomes the winner's slave and is mated". The story depicts how he uses his weakest skill "Copy" with the confidence that he has never lost in a "game" before, and how he manages to defeat the stronger players in a duel as if it were a game.
(Source: Comic Natalie)
